Bash(git merge main-monorepo -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Merge email scheduler timing fixes from main-monorepo

Brings in critical email scheduler fix:
- Fixed 30-minute delay for half-hour timezones \(IST, etc.\)
- Reduced data staleness window from 7 to 3 days
- Added user warnings for stale data
- Improved timezone handling and logging

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat\(client\): Add Firestore sync worker to fix email reports

CRITICAL FIX: Backend email scheduler requires data in Firestore, but client
only stored data locally in SQLite. This created a gap where no emails were
sent because backend had no data to work with.

Root Cause:
- Client: Local-first, stores all captures in SQLite
- Backend: Expects data in Firestore at usage/{userId}/dayBucket/{date}
- Missing: No sync mechanism to bridge SQLite → Firestore

Solution - Firestore Sync Worker:
- New background worker that syncs SQLite captures to Firestore daily
- Runs every 24 hours automatically in TUI app
- Syncs yesterday''s data \(complete\) to ensure emails work next day
- Smart date selection: only syncs dates with data, max 7-day lookback
- Handles long-running sessions correctly \(multi-day without restart\)

Features:
- Automatic daily sync \(24-hour interval\)
- Manual sync script for testing/recovery
- Incremental sync \(tracks last sync date, no duplicates\)
- Firestore REST API integration \(no Admin SDK required\)
- Robust error handling and logging
- Safe concurrent operation

Files Added:
- client/core/firestore_sync.py - Main sync worker
- client/manual_firestore_sync.py - Manual sync script
- client/FIRESTORE_SYNC_README.md - Complete documentation

Files Modified:
- client/core/database.py - Updated get_captures_for_date\(\) to accept strings
- client/tui/app.py - Integrated sync worker into TUI lifecycle

Testing:
Run manual sync to verify: python client/manual_firestore_sync.py

Impact:
- Fixes email reports \(backend now has data\)
- Enables server-side summary generation
- Supports users who run client 24/7 without restart

See FIRESTORE_SYNC_README.md for detailed architecture and usage.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
